title: Grateful Dead Live at Henry J Kaiser Convention Center on 1987-03-02
lineage: MAC > Nakamichi CR-5A > Edirol FA-66 > Wavelab 2448 > CD-Wave (24bit output) > TLH > FLAC 2448 tagged. Transferred by Andrew F. 03/2016
source: AUD: Unknown mics & lead deck > Sony TC-D5M > Maxell MX-Metal 90's. Recording by Jon Bernstein.

ai_review.summary: Excellent audience recording that captures the warm Kaiser‑era vibe, highlighted by a standout jam right before Truckin'.
ai_review.review: The three reviewers overwhelmingly praise the audio – it’s described as clean, full‑bodied and almost soundboard quality while retaining the natural warmth of an Aud capture. Musically the show is celebrated for its Kaiser‑tour feel and a memorable pre‑Truckin’ jam that makes the performance feel like a friendly gathering of locals.

ai_rating.rationale: Two strong 5‑star reviews highlight superb sound quality and an enjoyable performance; the lone 1‑star review is about a setlist typo, not the music or recording.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clean vocals and guitars, full‑bodied sound, cymbals audible; feels almost like a soundboard but warmer. Crowd singing is on a separate track – normal for Aud recordings.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The show evokes the Kaiser‑era atmosphere, with a relaxed party vibe and a notable jam leading into Truckin', giving the set a smooth, communal flow.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Guitar tone noted as clean and full, contributing to the warm sound.
